plotSections.title: Ord drawn into the door
bullets: On Gerk's turn, Ord is being sucked bodily into the door, into a wall of eyes just inside it. The eyes are focused on him and their pupils track him as he enters.
Ord babbles incoherently about sea breezes and something about his strength.
Gerk is no longer grappled: the tentacle was cut away. What remains is the door, Ord being pulled into it, and the wall of eyes.

plotSections.title: Breaking the floor under Ord
bullets: Gerk tries to stop Ord from going farther in by breaking the stone floor under him and pulling him down into the dirt so he cannot walk into the mass.

The floor is a cobble layer over a granular base, not solid stone all the way down. Gerk attacks it with his hammer (attack 15 against an inanimate object, 16 damage) and breaks up the cobbles under Ord.

Ord begins to stumble. The hand and arm already sucked into the mass are holding him up somewhat. Gerk starts to burrow under him and pull him down; the DM calls for Strength (Athletics) as he pulls. The check is not resolved in this chunk.

chronologicalEvents: Gerk's turn begins with Ord being pulled into the door and a wall of eyes inside it, all tracking him, while he babbles about sea breezes and his strength.
The DM confirms the grappling tentacle is gone; only the door, Ord being drawn in, and the wall of eyes remain.
Gerk hammers the cobble floor beneath Ord, hits with a 15, and deals 16 damage, breaking up the cobbles.
Ord stumbles, still held up by the arm already inside the mass. Gerk tries to pull him down into the broken floor and is asked for a Strength (Athletics) check.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: Being sucked bodily into the door and a wall of eyes that have focused on him, pupils tracking him as he enters.
Babbling incoherently about sea breezes and something about his strength.
After Gerk breaks the cobbles, Ord stumbles; the hand and arm already inside the mass hold him up somewhat.

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian Doorman and Child of the Great Eldarin Tree.
notes: No longer grappled; the tentacle that had held him was cut away.
Breaks the cobble floor under Ord with his hammer (attack 15, 16 damage) to drop Ord into a hole so he cannot continue into the door.
Starts to burrow under Ord and pull him down into the dirt; a Strength (Athletics) check is called and not yet resolved.

Door.existing: A door that stretches reality between places.
notes: Ord is being pulled into this door.
Just inside it is a wall of eyes focused on Ord.
A tentacle that had been present and grappling was cut away before this moment.
A wall full of eyes sits just inside the door.
Every eye focuses on Ord and the pupils track him as he is drawn in.
The hand and arm already sucked into the mass hold Ord up after the floor gives way.

misTranscriptions.notes: DM asks if Gerk wants to yawnk the hammer strike on the floor; repeated as a modifier ('ten plus a yonk').
Same floor-attack modifier as yawnk: 'ten plus a yonk' before 16 damage.
DM: 'You're gonna yawn at the floor,' same strike as yawnk/yonk.
DM says this while checking the floor damage; unclear whether a rule term or a mishear.
Sylan, as Gerk makes the Strength (Athletics) pull on Ord.
Part of Ord's incoherent babbling while being pulled into the wall of eyes; may be misheard in-world speech.

newTerms.name: Wall of Eyes
